description.en: Caller creates intense emotional distress claiming a young relative is arrested.
description.hi: कॉलर रिश्तेदार के जेल में होने का डर दिखाकर तुरंत पैसे मांगता है।

lines.text: Hello Uncle, please listen calmly, this is Sub-Inspector Rathore from Sector 18 station.
Your nephew Rohit was just apprehended in a major contraband raid outside college.

trueMarks.substring: apprehended in a major contraband raid

lines.text: The senior inspector is writing the official FIR diary as we speak right now.

trueMarks.explanation: Time pressure before legal records finalize

lines.text: Once entered into the national police portal, his career and future will be destroyed.

trueMarks.substring: career and future will be destroyed

lines.text: Do not call his parents or Rohit will face immediate lockup torture.

trueMarks.explanation: Cutting off communication with actual family
trueMarks.plainNote: tells you not to call parents

lines.text: Send seventy thousand rupees right now via UPI to settle medical release before filing.

trueMarks.substring: Send seventy thousand rupees right now via UPI
